description: The line plot illustrates the BPC (Bits Per Character) performance of two models—SMoE Validating and SimSMoE Validating—across training steps, with the x-axis representing training steps in thousands (ranging from 0 to 50×10³) and the y-axis showing BPC values from 1.2 to 2.2. The black line with 'x' markers, labeled "SMoE Validating," starts at a BPC of approximately 2.2 at 0 training steps and rapidly decreases to around 1.25 by 20×10³ steps, after which it stabilizes with minor fluctuations. The magenta line with circular markers, labeled "SimSMoE Validating," begins at a slightly lower BPC of about 2.15 and follows a similar trend, decreasing sharply to approximately 1.22 by 20×10³ steps and then plateauing with slight variations. Both models converge to nearly identical BPC values around 1.22–1.23 by the end of training, indicating comparable performance after initial training phases.
